resources.string: Axio shows a floating quick-action menu so you can go Back, go Home, open Notifications, lock the screen, or take a screenshot — all without leaving your current app. It does not read or collect any data from your screen.
Floating quick-action menu for common navigation actions
This service is used to display an overlay button for quick access to app features, enhancing user experience by providing quick access to the app\'s functionality from anywhere in the system.
